scope: One finite recursion supervision-span comparison, same real AB data in both arms. No new data, query supervision, architecture, encoder or controller change.
data: Same12newAB normal full4 chains,4percolor,A/B6each. All complete observed chains retained, including the actual failed close; no filtering by success or labels.
single: Exactly same previous single schedule in both arms:1000x64,48old+12newnormal+4newheldclosed, same sample order.

multi.root_balance: same12roots each4times per multi batch; same root ordering
multi.span3: prior two windows (open,lift,place) and (lift,place,close),each root/window twice; localdepth2 and3 each weight.25
multi.span4: one full(open,lift,place,close) chain from trueinitial,eachroot4times; depths2/3/4 weights.125/.25/.125
multi.loss_per_target: same feature_error+.25raw latentMSE, no query/semantic loss
multi.why_weights: span3 balanced windows induce globalweights.125/.25/.125. span4 preserves both their sum and global-position allocation, rather than merely adding supervision strength.
multi.difference: span4 replaces intermediate true-state starts with deeper predicted context and introduces depth4 gradient path. The place term no longer mixes depths2and3.
multi.compute: span3=48x3=144transition-state evaluations/multi-update,span4=48x4=192 (+33.3%). Including64single x1000, totals100000 vs112000(+12%). Decoder targets88000vs100000(+13.6%). Equal updates/draw schedules/weights, not equal FLOPs or walltime.

C_selection.score: From trueinitial recursively4steps; common weighted feature-only mean over steps2/3/4 with normalizedweights.25/.5/.25. Minimum,earlier tie. No latent/proposition score for selection.
C_selection.old_single_score: Retain previous .5oldC37root+.5newCselect6root one-step feature score as diagnostic only.
C_selection.isolation: Cvalidate6roots excluded from trainer/checkpoint selection; D3/D4 not accessed except immutable filehash verification. C has been repeatedly used for development; cannot call it fresh generalization evidence.

evaluation: All12AB train,6Cselect,6Cvalidate,percolor+globalstep full9/Holding/In/drawer,actualreadout,trueprevioussingle,initial-only full4,exactwindow1,per-root cumulative all4 correct. Normal primary,refusal separate.

gate.C_selection: selectedspan4commonmulti feature score strictly less than span3
gate.retention: eachseed first2recursive steps and every one-step skill may lose at most1/6C root; trainAB all4cumulative may lose at most1/12root; actualreadout must remain identical
gate.if_fail: Stop with no freshD collection and no additional tuning.
gate.interpretation: Operational advancement gate, not significance test or replacement project acceptance.

stop: After this finite stage return evidence to parent; never automatically start another model or correction.
